scope: Selected original main quest, Gael, Voraketh, refreshed quest and Babel scenes; receipt identity checks are distinct from content reading and exhaustive certification of inherited material. Quest authority governs compatible RP; claims retain speakers.

bodyEdits.before: His arc is not a hidden ascent toward greatness. It is the discovery that ordinary affection was already consequential. Dale helps make Fenumion worth saving because people enjoy living in a world where he is present.
bodyEdits.after: Dale’s place in the company rests on the life his friends share with him: music, meals, a wedding, jokes and his willingness to help. Their grief when he falls, and relief when he returns, make those ties visible alongside what he can do in a fight.
bodyEdits.reason: Replace a generalized greatness/affection conclusion with the already recorded shared life and responses to his loss and return; retain the importance of those relationships.

bodyEdits.before: This is care translated into method. It is also retrospective omnipotence. If every loss proves she should have been better prepared, then uncertainty itself becomes a personal moral failure.
bodyEdits.after: She answers the loss by asking what she should have known or prepared differently. That self-reproach is part of the account. Whether different preparation would have prevented the death is a separate question the record does not settle. She puts responsibility on herself even where the causes and alternatives remain uncertain.
bodyEdits.reason: Remove an inflated psychological label while retaining self-blame, preparation and uncertainty; do not certify the claim that she could have prevented the death.
